description: Checks supervisor rank for approval action and rank for sensitive updates.
Checks approval-token expiry, classified sharing, and missing approval for sensitive records.
Checks stale case assignment and uses assignment in routine allow logic.
Checks whether the requester credential is active.
Escalates emergency access for supervisory review.
Escalates requests that do not satisfy a routine allow rule and are not already denied.
Escalates degraded station-node status when the request is not an emergency.
Escalates juvenile, victim, or witness-sensitive records.
Checks recognized purpose and blocks training purpose on sensitive records.
Allows routine contextual access when request, purpose, action, sensitivity, assignment, and jurisdiction conditions are satisfied.
Checks sealed records and court/prosecution context.
Uses record sensitivity level in denial, escalation, and routine allow rules.
